versions.content: Mapping between the EcuAbstractionSwComponentType and the corresponding BswModuleDescription The BSW part is described by the means of the Basic Software Module Template . The mapping between the EcuAbstractionSwComponentType and the corresponding BswModuleDescrip- tion is provided by the class SwcBswMapping which in addition also maps the two corresponding InternalBehavior s. This mechanism is further explained in [6].
